## Lesson 4 — Optional: transform the floating coordinates {#lesson-ch4-transform}

### Branch another View from the same original Plan

This optional path repeats PTC, replaces the ordered public floating-node pair
with `floating.common` and `floating.differential`, then retains the two
feedline coordinates plus the differential coordinate. It neither mutates the
core View nor creates another physical Plan.

```{python}
#| id: ch4-derive-transformed-view
transformed_view = raw_loaded_view.reduce(
    ReductionPipeline()
    .ptc(probe_plus, probe_minus)
    .transform_pair(
        floating_plus,
        floating_minus,
        id="floating",
    )
    .retain(
        "feedline_in",
        "feedline_out",
        "floating.differential",
    )
)
```

The declared pipeline selects an analysis basis with explicit lineage. It does not
rename the two physical floating buses or alter the schematic.
